This tracked list is deliberately mechanical and topic-free. The corpus may extend it with
topic-specific terminology, which stays local with the corpus; pass --framing to use a merged
list. Adding a phrase here changes past-vs-future comparability, so the scorecard records the
prompt and corpus digests but NOT this file's — treat a change to it as a new baseline.
